terrainGrid.surfaceDefinition: fictional bare-earth DTM excluding buildings and vegetation
terrainGrid.accuracyStatement: Modeled terrain has no surveyed accuracy and is suitable only for game-world design.

terrainLayers.algorithm: authored constraints plus seeded multiscale interpolated noise
Whitebox least-cost breach plus residual fill, with declared natural depressions restored
single receiver toward a declared terminal
MFD at 32 meters, log wetness proxy expanded to DTM alignment

topologyRules.rule: territory polygons exhaustively and exclusively cover the atlas extent
each site is strictly inside its declared territory
all settlement and proof-location sites participate in one bidirectional walking graph
each named modeled bed profile descends strictly to one declared terminal
declared bridge points must intersect one route section and one stream
